info.title: ContainerInstanceManagementClient

requests.description: List the operations for Azure Container Instance service.
requests.name: GET /providers/Microsoft.ContainerInstance/operations

requests.description: Get a list of container groups in the specified subscription. This operation returns properties of each container group including containers, image registry credentials, restart policy, IP address type, OS type, state, and volumes.
requests.name: Get a list of container groups in the specified subscription.
requests.note: Replace {{CONTAINERINSTANCEMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Get a list of container groups in the specified subscription.

requests.description: Get the list of cached images on specific OS type for a subscription in a region.
requests.name: Get the list of cached images.
requests.note: Replace {{CONTAINERINSTANCEMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Get the list of cached images.
